_comment: Accepted codegen-differential defects, per (component, attribute, platform, check). An entry means the converter demonstrably fails that judgement and the failure is accepted FOR A STATED REASON — not that it is fine. Unrecorded defects fail `jui conformance gate --codegen-effect`; entries the measurement no longer supports are stale and fail too, so fixing a defect forces its row out (the one-directional version lets a fixed row sit here forever, which is how the previous freeze ledgers rotted). Advisory classes (value-is-default, numeric-string-divergence) are re-derived every run and are deliberately absent. Reason 'unreviewed-initial-measurement' marks the initial-measurement backlog — consume it.

entries.owner: A (rjui) — probe value fix owned by D
entries.reason: NOT an unread spelling. collection_converter.rb:149-151 reads it and every container branch acts on it: static `none` drops the overflow scroll classes (measured: CONTROL/lazy/eager byte-identical, none differs), and the bound form emits a runtime overflow override in all three branches. The C0 verdict is an artifact of the value plan: representative_value('Collection','lazy') is 'lazy' — the declared DEFAULT — so emit(v1) equals the control by construction, and the second value 'eager' also equals it because lazy-vs-eager is virtualization, which the plain `.map()` emit does not have. `none` is the only web-observable value and the probe never picks it.
entries.note: Accepted degeneracy: web lazy≡eager (no virtualization to switch off). Probe fix: representative value `none` in rules.py (D's file, not touched here).
